hackathons.title: Capture the flag 2026 – Campus edition
hackathons.summary: This campus edition cybersecurity CTF hackathon is organized by KPMG in India to engage students in real-world security challenges. Participants dive into hands-on ethical hacking tasks to demonstrate their skills in a competitive environment.

hackathons.title: ByteMe CTF 26
hackathons.summary: ByteMe CTF 26 is a cybersecurity competition hosted by OWASP PCCoE on the CTF7 platform. It tests participants on key cybersecurity domain challenges such as ethical hacking and vulnerability exploitation.

hackathons.title: Black Hat India 2026 Official CTF
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and cybersecurity professionals
hackathons.summary: Black Hat India 2026 Official CTF is a cybersecurity challenge hosted on CTF7. The event focuses on evaluating participants' technical expertise across various security and exploitation disciplines.

hackathons.title: Arc Microgrants | Circle
hackathons.eligibility: Open to all developers and students
hackathons.summary: This online competition hosted by Circle offers microgrants for innovative software projects. Participants can submit tech builds to compete for a share of the $6,000 grant pool.

hackathons.title: AI Lodge Hackathon 2026
hackathons.summary: Organized by Singapore Management University, this online hackathon focuses on developing novel artificial intelligence solutions. Teams can build projects to win a share of the $2,500 prize pool.

hackathons.title: Multimodal AI Hackathon 2026
hackathons.organizer: KamandPrompt – Programming Club of IIT Mandi
hackathons.eligibility: Open to engineering and tech students
hackathons.summary: Hosted by KamandPrompt, the programming club of IIT Mandi, this online hackathon focuses on multimodal artificial intelligence models. Participants collaborate to create innovative AI solutions and win awards.

hackathons.title: Build With AI: Basics 2026
hackathons.summary: This online competition by Devpost invites developers to build foundational artificial intelligence applications. Participants can showcase their coding skills and compete for $850 in prizes.

hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon on Sustainable Transport Engineering
hackathons.eligibility: Engineering students and young engineers under 30
hackathons.summary: The 2027 WFEO Hackathon invites engineering students and young engineers to solve challenges focused on sustainable transport engineering. Participants work in multidisciplinary teams over a three-week online hackathon period.
